report.explanation: Alert cites checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, order error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, and order checkout trace OK. Only a single gateway trace shows an ERROR call to order, and order shows retained heap after GC warnings. These are insufficient to establish a bounded root cause; operator hypothesis of memory leak lacks a retention trend. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces showing order-side errors or elevated latency aligned with the alert window
Gateway metrics showing elevated error rate or p95 latency during the alert window
Order memory-retention time series across multiple windows to establish a leak trend
Evidence linking the order 3.3.9 deployment to observed latency or errors
